sources.title: Fibered knots with the same 0-surgery and the slice-ribbon conjecture
sources.date: First submitted February 2015; inspected arXiv v5, 8 September 2016
sources.claim_used: Distinct fibered knots with irreducible Alexander polynomials give a nonribbon difference; the paper applies this to its 6_3 annulus-twist pair.
sources.limits: Application to repository PDs still requires exact correspondence. Does not imply concordance from common 0-surgery.

sources.title: Nonsimple, ribbon fibered knots
sources.date: 1994, Transactions of the American Mathematical Society 341
locations: Theorem 5.5, as reproduced in Abe-Tagami Appendix A
sources.claim_used: Prime fibered summands satisfying the individual minimality or nonunit norm-factor exclusion hypotheses must pair appropriately in a homotopically ribbon sum.
sources.limits: Direct original retrieval failed. Do not claim the original proof was read.

sources.title: A construction of slice knots via annulus modifications
sources.date: arXiv first submission 1 December 2015; retrieved PDF internally dated 29 October 2021
locations: Theorem 3.3 (also announced as Theorem 3.1 in the introduction)
sources.claim_used: A modifying annulus must be disjoint from the chosen disk and satisfy the standard-annulus hypotheses for the standard-B4 conclusion; l-nice alone yields a weaker exotic-ball conclusion.
sources.limits: No target annulus meeting the hypotheses was constructed. Figure 7 screenshot inspected; the attempted screenshot of the following page failed.

sources.title: Ribbon concordances and slice obstructions: experiments and examples
sources.claim_used: Ribbon certificates for J and K#J imply K slice; the paper also states the converse existence characterization, citing Teichner Lemma 2.5.
sources.limits: The easy cancellation implication was reasoned directly. Original Teichner lecture-note proof was not separately retrieved. No finite bound on a successful partner is supplied.

sources.title: A Dunfield-Gong 4-Sphere is Standard
sources.claim_used: The preprint supplies standard-B4 sliceness for 18nh00000601 and separately discusses handle-ribbonness.
sources.limits: The named knot and theorem statement were checked; the full Kirby proof and identification of the stored target PD were not independently certified. Retrieved rendering also displayed a later internal date; no dating inference was made from that inconsistency.

sources.title: The Jones polynomial of ribbon links
sources.date: Geometry & Topology 13 (2009), 623-660; first arXiv submission 15 February 2008
sources.claim_used: A ribbon pattern means its zero-framed unknot satellite is ribbon. Applying such a pattern to a ribbon companion yields a ribbon link; the Jones nullity and mod-32 criteria are necessary.
sources.limits: No claim that a non-concordance invariant must distinguish any fixed slice knot. Questions in this paper are not asserted to remain unresolved today, and passing cable examples do not prove universal vacuity.

sources.title: Equivalent characterizations of handle-ribbon knots
sources.claim_used: Ribbonness is equivalent to existence of an unlink derivative on some Seifert surface; handle-ribbonness corresponds instead to an R-link derivative.
sources.limits: No minimal-genus or single-fiber restriction in the ribbon characterization; a finite derivative search is not a global nonribbon theorem.
